title: Coventry Peace Orchard volunteers receive King's Award for Voluntary Service
summary: Community group behind unique peace and remembrance project honoured with UK’s highest award for volunteer groups

title: 16 Days of Activism – remembering women
summary: A Coventry Counts Dead Women Vigil will be held next to the Fountain in Coventry City Centre on Saturday 28 November in commemoration of women who have been killed by men in the past year.

title: Carers Trust recognise Council's digital inclusion work
summary: The Council's digital inclusion programme, #CovConnects, has won an award from Carers Trust (Heart of England - Coventry & Warwickshire) for its commitment to helping local unpaid carers get online.

title: 16 Days of Activism Against Gender Based Violence
summary: Coventry organisations are joining forces to raise awareness of gender-based violence.

title: Festival of Christmas returns to the city centre for spectacular festive celebration
summary: The annual Festival of Christmas will return to Coventry’s city centre on Saturday 21 November for an afternoon and evening of festive fun!

title: Council report forecasts finance underspend
summary: Coventry City Council will report on a revenue forecast, at the end of September 2026, of £4.3m under budget.
